Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 88: October 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #88 shipped to subscribers in September 2008 (bearing the cover date of October 2008 for Issue 88). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #88 featured a robust fall lineup of high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, unlockable content, and exclusive media previews:

Pure (high-flying off-road ATV quad racing)
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 09 (golf simulation)
NHL 09 (ice hockey simulation)
BAJA: Edge of Control (off-road desert racing simulation)
Galaga Legions (Xbox Live Arcade arcade shooter remaster)
Castle Crashers (Xbox Live Arcade 2D co-op hack-and-slash beat 'em up)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc featured downloadable content (including unlockable Team Fortress 2 gamerpics and Mirror's Edge concept art), offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Resident Evil 5, Fable II, and Gears of War 2, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
